description: Set the complete track order of one collection: tracks lists every item exactly once. Use it to rearrange a whole collection. Not for moving a single item; use update_collection_item with position for that. Returns the updated collection. Needs a signed-in account. Side effects: the new order and a new revision. Fails when tracks leaves out or repeats an item, or with stale_revision when revision is out of date. Sending the previous order undoes it. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","tracks":["ic-ccab784f22","fp-a3e107a24c"],"revision":4}.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

revision.description: The collection's current revision, returned by get_collection or list_collections; when given, the change fails with stale_revision if the collection was edited since.

tracks.description: Every track id in the collection exactly once, in the new order, as returned by get_collection.

name: reorder_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Reorder a collection
